/* PocketStory V3 floating story captions */
.float-layer{position:absolute;inset:47px 0 20px;pointer-events:none;z-index:18;overflow:hidden}
.narration-tap-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:17;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;touch-action:manipulation;}
.narration-progress{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:35px;transform:translateX(-50%);pointer-events:none;background:#1c1525bb;color:white;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 14px #0003;}
.narration-progress.waiting{animation:narrHint 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
@keyframes narrHint{from{opacity:.65}to{opacity:1}}

.float-caption{position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;max-width:94%;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.4;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:opacity .2s}
.float-caption.float-edit{pointer-events:auto;cursor:grab;user-select:none;border:1px dashed #9779d9;outline:3px solid #f6ebff88}
.float-caption.float-edit:active{cursor:grabbing}
.float-caption.float-active{outline:2px solid #9968ff;outline-offset:3px}
.float-caption.float-enter{animation:floatIn .45s ease both}
@keyframes floatIn{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(5px);transform:translate(-50%,-40%)}to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}}
.float-hint{font-size:11px;color:#8e82a5;background:#f7f1ff;padding:10px;border-radius:9px;margin:12px 0}

.sidebar-app-actions{padding:8px 18px;display:grid;gap:7px}.sidebar-app-actions .btn{width:100%}.sidebar-app-actions small{font-size:10px;color:#9a90a0}
.navitem[draggable=true]{cursor:grab}.navitem.dragover{outline:2px dashed #9176cd;background:#f2ebff}.navitem .mini-order{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:3px}.mini-order button{border:1px solid #ece7f4;background:#fff;color:#7b65aa;border-radius:6px;padding:1px 5px;font-size:12px}.mini-order button:hover{background:#ece4fc}
.v4-modal-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#16121c9e;z-index:200;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:15px}.v4-modal{width:min(580px,100%);max-height:85vh;overflow-y:auto;background:white;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 24px 90px #0005}.v4-modal-head,.v4-modal-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.v4-modal h2{margin:0;font-size:19px}.slot{border:1px solid #e8e1ef;border-radius:13px;padding:13px;margin:12px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between}.slot small{color:#999;display:block}.slot .actions{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}.slot .actions button{padding:7px;font-size:11px}.v4-help{padding:12px;border:1px solid #ded1f4;background:#f8f4ff;border-radius:12px;margin:10px 0;line-height:1.8}.v4-help button{float:right;border:0;background:#eae2f8;border-radius:7px;padding:2px 8px;cursor:pointer}.v4-hint-panel{padding:14px;max-width:550px;margin:auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e9e4ec;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 7px 20px #28202a10}.v4-hint-panel h3{margin:0 0 12px}.v4-hint-panel .hint-item{padding:10px;margin:9px 0;background:#f7f4fa;border-radius:9px}.v4-hint-panel .hint-item p{white-space:pre-wrap}.v4-hint-trigger{position:absolute;right:11px;bottom:24px;z-index:27;border:0;border-radius:99px;background:#fffde9eb;padding:8px 12px;color:#6b517a;box-shadow:0 5px 16px #0003;font-size:12px}
.group-sender{font-size:10px;color:#766b82;margin:0 0 4px 4px;font-weight:700}.group-msg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;max-width:90%}.group-msg.mine{align-self:flex-end;align-items:flex-end}.group-msg .bubble{align-self:inherit;max-width:100%}.group-avatar{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#efe6f7;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px;margin-right:6px}.group-row-label{font-size:10px;color:#a595a9;padding:12px 16px 5px;font-weight:700}.group-members{font-size:10px;color:#9a929f}.group-check{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:7px 0;font-size:12px}.group-check input{width:auto}.group-box{background:#f7f4fb;border:1px solid #e8e1f1;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;margin:10px 0}.group-box button{margin-top:7px} .inline-reorder{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:5px;justify-content:flex-end}.inline-reorder button{background:#fff9;border:1px solid #bcaade;color:#69518f;border-radius:6px;padding:1px 8px;cursor:pointer}.inline-reorder button:hover{background:#e6dcf8}.msg-options:empty{display:none}.msg-options button{min-height:32px}.choice-editor{margin-top:11px} .option-preview-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#75668a;text-align:center;padding:5px 0}.preview-choice{opacity:.9!important;background:#eee9f7!important;color:#55466c!important;cursor:default!important}.inline-reorder button{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;min-width:27px} .msg-options{max-height:35%;overflow:auto} .unread-dot{display:inline-flex;float:right;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#ed577a;color:white;font-weight:750;font-size:11px;border-radius:16px;padding:3px 7px;min-width:21px;margin:0 8px}.rule-hint{font-size:12px;color:#887995;padding:9px}.rule-once{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;margin:12px 0}.rule-once input{width:auto}.story-panel textarea{width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #e2d9e9;border-radius:9px;font:inherit}.story-panel .field{margin-top:12px}
/* V15: 来电是虚拟手机内部的独立顶层界面，不依赖浏览器弹窗 */
.call-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:110;background:#241d2a;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:auto;isolation:isolate}
.call-overlay>.page-ui{height:100%}.call-overlay .call-screen{height:100%;padding-top:72px}
.call-overlay .call-actions{margin-top:70px}
.call-locked-tip{color:#f2c5d9!important;font-size:12px;background:#ffffff16;display:inline-block;border-radius:18px;padding:7px 12px}

/* PocketStory V19 · iOS-inspired visual system + interactive story direction */

.phone-screen{border-radius:46px;isolation:isolate;--ios-accent:#1877f2;--ios-own:#95EC69;--ios-incoming:#e9ebef;--ios-page:#f8f9fb;--ios-font:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"PingFang SC",sans-serif;font-family:var(--ios-font)}
.phone-screen:before{width:260px;height:260px;left:-35%;opacity:.35;top:0}.island{top:8px;height:29px;width:107px;background:#090a0d;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #0003}.phone-status{height:54px;padding:14px 27px 0;font-size:12px;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--ios-status,#232730);text-shadow:0 1px 4px #fff4}.phone-content{top:54px;bottom:18px}.desktop{padding:66px 16px 26px}.app-grid{gap:23px 8px}.app-icon{height:57px;width:57px;border-radius:15px;font-size:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff55,0 5px 12px #14274532}.app-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:550;text-shadow:0 1px 5px #fff8}.dock{background:#ffffff83;border:1px solid #fff9;backdrop-filter:blur(25px);padding:13px 9px;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 3px 16px #0001}.dock .app-icon{height:53px;width:53px}
.page-ui{background:var(--ios-page);font-family:var(--ios-font)}.page-head{height:57px;background:#f8f9fbf2;border-color:#e6e8ed;backdrop-filter:blur(15px)}.back{color:var(--ios-accent);font-size:30px}.page-head strong{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.25px}.messages{background:var(--ios-page);padding:18px 12px;gap:10px}.bubble{background:var(--ios-incoming);border-radius:18px 18px 18px 6px;color:#212733;line-height:1.52;padding:10px 13px;box-shadow:0 1px 1px #00000008}.bubble.me{background:var(--ios-own);border-radius:18px 18px 6px 18px}.msg-input{border-top:1px solid #e4e7ed;background:#ffffffea}.msg-options,.group-choice-panel{background:var(--ios-page)}.msg-options button,.group-choice-panel button{border-radius:13px}
.list-row{border-color:#e8ebf1}.avatar{background:#e5e8f0}.group-row-label{color:#738197}.v4-hint-trigger{z-index:42;background:#fffefcdd;color:#2956a5;border:1px solid #dce5f1}.home-indicator{background:var(--ios-status,#242732);height:5px;z-index:43}
.cn-time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.2px;font-size:13px}.cn-date{font-size:11px;opacity:.85}.status-right{margin-left:auto;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:12px}
.phone-screen.fx-shake{animation:psShake .5s linear 2}.phone-screen.fx-glitch{animation:psGlitch .3s steps(2) 4}.phone-screen.fx-pulse{animation:psPulse .6s ease-in-out 2}.phone-screen.fx-redflash:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:75;background:#ff203c77;pointer-events:none;animation:psFlash .3s step-end 5}.phone-screen.fx-blackout:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:75;background:#000;pointer-events:none;animation:psFlash .4s step-end 3}
@keyframes psShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0)}20%{transform:translate(-7px,3px)}40%{transform:translate(6px,-2px)}60%{transform:translate(-5px,-4px)}80%{transform:translate(7px,2px)}}
@keyframes psGlitch{0%,100%{filter:none;transform:translateX(0)}20%{filter:hue-rotate(125deg) contrast(2);transform:translateX(-5px)}50%{filter:invert(.85);transform:translateX(6px)}70%{filter:saturate(3);transform:translateX(-3px)}}
@keyframes psPulse{50%{filter:contrast(1.55) brightness(.45)}}@keyframes psFlash{0%,100%{opacity:0}50%{opacity:1}}
.ios-notice{position:absolute;top:62px;left:12px;right:12px;z-index:32;background:#f8f9ffed;border:1px solid #fff;border-radius:17px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #23344c43;font-size:12px}
.cinema-scene{height:100%;width:100%;overflow:hidden;position:relative;isolation:isolate}.scene-background{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-1}.scene-label{position:absolute;top:11px;left:18px;font-size:11px;color:#fff9;letter-spacing:.2em}.scene-element{position:absolute;max-width:90%;padding:10px;border:1px solid transparent;white-space:pre-wrap;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);text-align:center;line-height:1.7;text-shadow:0 3px 13px #0006}.scene-element.scene-selected{border:1px dashed #d2b4ff;border-radius:10px;background:#ffffff17;cursor:grab}.scene-choices{position:absolute;bottom:26px;left:16px;right:16px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-direction:column;max-height:55%;overflow:auto}.scene-choices button{border:1px solid #ffffff90;color:white;background:#171820bb;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-radius:13px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;font-size:13px}.scene-choices button:hover{background:#3d3853df}.end-screen{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:50;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#120e1ee9,#25254aee);color:white;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:35px 24px}.end-screen.he{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ecdbdbed,#c3cfeced);color:#3c3757}.end-screen.be{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#090707f5,#390c1aed);color:#f3dadd}.end-screen h2{font-size:31px;letter-spacing:4px;margin:12px 0 16px;font-weight:300}.end-screen p{line-height:1.9;white-space:pre-wrap}.end-screen button{margin-top:15px;background:#ffffff29;color:inherit;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 18px}.end-screen .ending-back-help{display:block;margin-top:10px;max-width:270px;line-height:1.6;opacity:.75;font-size:11px}
.studio{width:min(900px,100%);display:grid;gap:16px}.studio h2{margin:5px 0}.studio-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e1e7ef;border-radius:18px;padding:19px;box-shadow:0 6px 20px #283b5710}.studio-card h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:16px}.studio-card .field{margin:9px 0}.studio-card .field label{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#647088;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:4px}.studio-card input,.studio-card select,.studio-card textarea,.scene-inspector input,.scene-inspector select,.scene-inspector textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid #dfe4ed;background:white;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;font:inherit;font-size:12px}.studio-card textarea{min-height:54px}.studio-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.studio-item{padding:13px;border:1px solid #e5e9f1;background:#f8f9fd;border-radius:12px}.studio-item strong{display:block;margin-bottom:7px}.studio-item .actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:9px}.studio-item button,.studio button{cursor:pointer}.studio .btn{white-space:normal}.studio small{color:#6b7280}.studio-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;color:#2764ce;background:#eaf1ff;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:99px;margin-bottom:7px}.sidebar-scenes{padding:5px 12px 9px}.sidebar-scenes button{width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;background:transparent;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;color:#566174;font-size:12px}.sidebar-scenes button:hover,.sidebar-scenes button.selected{background:#eaf1ff;color:#1357b6}.scene-inspector{display:grid;gap:8px}.scene-inspector label{font-size:11px;color:#6b7687;font-weight:600}.small-muted{font-size:11px;color:#788397}.play-progress{font-size:10px;text-align:center;padding:3px;color:#6b7e93}.char-reveal{animation:msgEnter .3s ease both}@keyframes msgEnter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(max-width:1000px){.workspace{grid-template-columns:190px minmax(345px,1fr) 280px}.topbar{height:auto;min-height:67px;padding:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.top-actions{flex-wrap:wrap}.top-actions .btn{padding:7px 9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.phone-screen.fx-shake,.phone-screen.fx-glitch,.phone-screen.fx-pulse,.phone-screen.fx-redflash:after,.phone-screen.fx-blackout:after,.char-reveal{animation:none!important}}
 .page-ui .page-body[style*="background"]{background:var(--ios-page)!important}
.messages>.bubble:last-child,.messages>.group-msg:last-child{animation:none}

/* PocketStory V22 · WeChat-inspired chat UI */
.app-icon.wechat-icon{position:relative;background:#07C160!important;overflow:hidden}
.app-icon.wechat-icon:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:29px;height:22px;left:9px;top:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #006d351f}
.app-icon.wechat-icon:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:20px;height:16px;right:6px;bottom:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#dff8e8;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #006d351f}
.app-icon.wechat-icon .wechat-eyes{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:16px;top:19px;width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#07C160;box-shadow:7px 0 #07C160,9px 10px #07C160,15px 10px #07C160;pointer-events:none}
.wechat-toolbar{padding:10px 14px 4px;background:var(--ios-page)}
.wechat-search{width:100%;height:31px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#eceef2;color:#8b919b;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px}
.wechat-row-unread{background:#f7fff9}
.wechat-row-unread .row-data strong{font-weight:750;color:#1e252b}
.wechat-section-label{padding:10px 17px 4px;color:#9298a2;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.3px}


/* V26 · 更清晰的剧情触发条件选择器 */
.trigger-selector{width:100%;min-width:0;border:1px solid #d5d8df;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#262a32;padding:10px 11px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;max-width:100%}
.trigger-selector:focus,.event-custom-input:focus{outline:2px solid #97a8fc;outline-offset:1px}
.event-custom-input{margin-top:8px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid #aeb4c8;border-radius:9px;padding:10px}

/* PocketStory 独立游玩版：所有编辑器功能被隐藏，游戏玩法和剧情引擎保持原样 */
body{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#110e16 0%,#222030 55%,#121521 100%);}
.app-shell{min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;height:100vh;height:100svh;}
.topbar{background:#191820;color:#f7effd;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff19;flex-shrink:0;height:58px;min-height:58px;padding:0 20px;}
.brand .mark{background:#ffffff1c;color:#eecfeb}
.brand strong{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.2px;color:#f6eafa}
.brand small{font-size:10px;color:#b8acbe;letter-spacing:2px}
.top-center,.sidebar,.inspector,.canvas-head,.footer-tip,#resetBtn,#importBtn,#exportBtn,#saveBtn{display:none!important}
.top-actions #gameSaveBtn{color:#e7e0ec;background:#ffffff15;border:1px solid #ffffff35;font-weight:650}
.top-actions #gameSaveBtn:hover{background:#ffffff26}
.workspace{display:flex!important;justify-content:center;align-items:center;min-height:0;height:calc(100svh - 58px);overflow:hidden;}
.center{flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:0;height:100%;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 36%,#413a4e 0%,#25212e 42%,#13121c 95%)}
#mainStage{margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:none!important;flex-shrink:0;zoom:var(--player-scale,1);}
.phone-frame{transform:none!important;margin:0!important;box-shadow:0 28px 85px #0009,0 5px 18px #0005;}
#playerWelcome{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 35% 20%,#483047 0%,#171420 55%,#10131b 100%);color:#f5eaf4;text-align:center;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Microsoft Yahei',sans-serif}
.welcome-inner{max-width:430px;width:100%;padding:30px 18px}
.welcome-moon{font-size:35px;color:#bc9fbf;letter-spacing:9px;margin-bottom:26px}
.welcome-inner h1{font-size:clamp(28px,7.5vw,44px);font-weight:650;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:2px;margin:0 0 15px}
.welcome-inner p{color:#c4b3c4;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.9}
#beginStory{display:block;width:min(290px,100%);margin:36px auto 15px;padding:15px 24px;color:#241a2a;background:#f0dfe9;border:0;border-radius:14px;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 26px #0006}
.welcome-inner .tiny{font-size:11px;color:#9a889a;letter-spacing:0}
@media(max-width:760px){.app-shell{height:100svh;min-height:0}.topbar{padding:0 12px;flex-wrap:nowrap;justify-content:space-between}.topbar .brand small{display:block}.workspace{flex-direction:row!important;height:calc(100svh - 58px)}.center{min-height:0;padding:0}.phone-frame{transform:none!important}.top-actions #gameSaveBtn{padding:8px 10px}}
@media(max-width:360px){.topbar .brand strong{font-size:13px}.brand .mark{width:28px;height:28px}}
